workflow.codeReviewerVerdict: Core logic correct (serialize-once, byte accounting, counter monotonicity, resume restore confirmed). 2 Major edge-case findings, both pre-existing/native-consistent — recorded as accepted risks; misleading comment repaired.
acceptedRisks: R1 (Major, pre-existing): a single record larger than the publisher per-part cap escapes the page-loop catch filters (publisher throws non-AdapterHttp/Json/Xml). Pre-dates this change (old single-publish path identical). Comment corrected; full guard deferred.

R2 (Major, native-consistent): partial-publish-then-resume relies on deterministic re-slicing of the same page; a vendor returning different bytes on re-fetch could orphan a higher-numbered file. Same assumption native documents for deterministic re-pagination.
R3 (Minor): ThrottlingOptions.Resolve throws on MaxBytesPerBatch<=0 outside a try; pages metric counts pagination pages not published files. Cosmetic/edge — deferred.
